timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1500–1510 KRW/USD (expected lower level) vs. recent highs above that

WHY: The news indicates the won has weakened to 17-year highs (high KRW/USD), making dollars expensive right now. While one article suggests potential decline toward 1500–1510 range due to easing Middle East tensions, the second article emphasizes the won is currently at crisis-level weakness, meaning you are paying more KRW per dollar at this moment.

TIP: If possible, consider waiting a few days or weeks for the anticipated decline toward 1500 range before converting your monthly $2,000, or split purchases across multiple months to reduce timing risk.

articles.summary: 원·달러 환율이 1500원대(1500~1510) 까지 내려설 수 있다는 전망이 나오고 있다. 미국과 이란 간 긴장 완화 기대감으로 글로벌 금융시장의 위험선호 심리.

articles.title: 고삐 풀린 환율 17년래 최고…실물경제 ‘휘청’
articles.summary: 원·달러 환율이 금융위기 수준까지 치솟으며 실물경제에 부담을 줄 수 있다는 우려가 커지고 있다. 금융당국의 구두 개입에 상승세는 일단 진정됐지.
